patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the contents of the downloaded patch archive into the game install folder mentioned above, overwriting the files when prompted It's working if: No comic bunnies appear during lewd scenes. For example, the first time you leave the house, re-enter the house and use the bathroom - no bunnies should appear. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
